title: Porsche Newsroom US: Porsche expands all-electric SUV model lineup with the Cayenne S (2026)
notes: Cayenne S "will also come standard with a Porsche CCS DC Adapter"; "Like all Cayenne Electric models" it has a J3400 (NACS) DC-only port on the driver-side rear fender and a J1772 AC-only port. No heat pump mention.
